tasks.label: Stop Backend (Django)
args: $port=8000; $connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $pids = $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($pid in $pids) { Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host "Stopped Django on port $port" } else { Write-Host "Django not running on port $port" }

tasks.label: Stop ML-Backend (FastAPI)
args: $port=8100; $connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $pids = $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($pid in $pids) { Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host "Stopped ML-Backend on port $port" } else { Write-Host "ML-Backend not running on port $port" }

tasks.label: Stop Frontend (Next.js)
args: $port=3000; $connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $pids = $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($pid in $pids) { Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host "Stopped Frontend on port $port" } else { Write-Host "Frontend not running on port $port" }

tasks.label: Backend (Django)
args: $port=8000; if (-not (Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 127.0.0.1 -Port $port -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue)) { & '${workspaceFolder}/Backend/venv/Scripts/python.exe' manage.py runserver 8000 } else { Write-Host "Django already running on port $port" }

tasks.label: ML-Backend (FastAPI)
args: $port=8100; if (-not (Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 127.0.0.1 -Port $port -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue)) { & '${workspaceFolder}/ML-Backend/.venv/Scripts/uvicorn.exe' app.main:app --port 8100 } else { Write-Host "ML-Backend already running on port $port" }

tasks.label: Frontend (Next.js)
args: $port=3000; if (-not (Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 127.0.0.1 -Port $port -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue)) { npm.cmd run dev } else { Write-Host "Frontend already running on port $port" }
